test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_single_block_{codec} ( ts DateTime, msg String, INDEX idx msg TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, posting_list_codec = '{codec}') ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toDate(ts) ORDER BY ts
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_single_block_{codec} SELECT toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00') + intDiv(number * 950400, 10000000), concat(multiIf(cityHash64(number, 1) % 100 < 25, 'ERROR', cityHash64(number, 1) % 100 < 35, 'WARN', 'INFO'), ' request ', toString(number % 1000), if(cityHash64(number, 2) % 100 < 5, ' timeout', ''), if(cityHash64(number, 3) % 1000 = 0, ' panic', ''), ' done') FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_single_block_{codec} WHERE hasToken(msg, 'ERROR')
SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS h, count() FROM text_index_single_block_{codec} WHERE hasAnyTokens(msg, ['timeout', 'ERROR']) GROUP BY h FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM text_index_single_block_{codec} WHERE hasToken(msg, 'panic')
